_comment: Seed list of NYC employers for ATS token discovery (task 16). This file BOOTSTRAPS the ats_seed table; it is not the source of truth. Once migrations/migrate_company_ats.py has loaded it, adding an employer is an INSERT (or `tools/ats-discover.py --add-employer`), never an edit here followed by a deploy -- git show refactor-freeze-2026-08-02:docs/tasks/refactor/tranche_three/16-ats-token-discovery.md:34, 'store as a simple seeded table, not a config file'. Re-running the loader is idempotent and never deletes rows added directly to the table.
_why_weighted_non_tech: git show refactor-freeze-2026-08-02:docs/pursuit-gate-volume.md measured 90% of the corpus arriving from greenhouse + ashby alone, and Google Jobs contributing 4.8%. The broad-industry, non-tech NYC employers the Pursuit cohort targets are absent from every configured source. So this list is deliberately ~97% non-tech: health, education, government, nonprofit, finance, insurance, media, retail, real estate, professional services, transport, arts and hospitality. The ten tech entries are present only as a positive control -- they are companies already known to run Greenhouse or Ashby, so a run that finds nothing for them has a probe bug, not an empty market.
_what_a_row_means: employer_name is the display name and the identity of a never_found row. careers_url is a STARTING POINT, not an assertion: it is hand-assembled and employers move these paths constantly, so the probe falls back to {origin}/careers and {origin}/jobs before concluding anything. A 404 on all three is recorded as missing_page, which is explicitly NOT the same as 'this employer has no ATS'. sector drives is_non_tech, which is what the coverage fraction in git show refactor-freeze-2026-08-02:docs/ats-token-discovery.md is computed over.
_sources_not_yet_included: Adzuna top_companies (task 15) is listed at git show refactor-freeze-2026-08-02:docs/tasks/refactor/tranche_three/16-ats-token-discovery.md:32 as a discovery source and is NOT represented here: task 15 is blocked on an Adzuna app_id/app_key that requires registering an account, and nobody has. It is a pluggable input rather than a missing one -- see adzuna_top_companies() in tools/ats-discover.py, which is the stub that switches on once credentials exist. Apify's discovery actors (igolaizola/greenhouse-companies, wickfeed/ats-company-discovery) are the other bootstrap route named by the task and are likewise not used here; the task itself says to own the maintenance rather than build a dependency on them.
